reason: In freight, people give cargo to people they know and trust; a cold email from a warmed-up domain does not get me a shipper, my calls and the fairs do. I would maybe take the free 15-company sample out of curiosity, but I would not put EUR 1,500 down this month.
objection: Cold outreach in logistics mostly gets you price-shoppers asking for a quote, not real accounts. And if it does work, I could buy Apollo and hire a junior SDR for less and keep the know-how in-house.
would_change_my_mind: Talking directly to the past logistics client and hearing that those 45 meetings turned into signed freight contracts, not just calls, plus a sample list that names companies I don't already know.
